title: Microsoft and Anthropic Join Forces: Claude AI Models Now Power Microsoft 365 Copilot
summary: Microsoft integrates Anthropic's Claude AI models—Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.1—into Microsoft 365 Copilot, expanding AI model choice for enterprises. This collaboration boosts productivity by enhancing reasoning, workflow automation, and research capabilities, positioning Microsoft as a leader in AI‑driven enterprise solutions.
body_markdown: Microsoft's integration of Anthropic's Claude AI into the Microsoft 365 Copilot represents a significant leap in AI‑driven productivity tools. This integration allows enterprise users to access advanced AI models such as Claude Sonnet 4 and Opus 4.1, expanding the functionality of Microsoft 365 Copilot dramatically. Claude AI models, known for their safety and contextual reasoning capabilities, are designed to enhance complex workflow tasks, making Microsoft 365 a more versatile tool for businesses. By offering a choice between various AI models, Microsoft aims to cater to diverse business needs, providing flexibility and tailored solutions for enterprise users looking to automate and optimize their processes in innovative ways. More details on these enhancements can be found in.[2](https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/science/microsoft-integrates-anthropic-s-claude-ai-into-copilot/story) Businesses adopting enterprise AI frequently engage a[Microsoft Copilot consulting partner](https://www.velosio.com/products/microsoft-copilot/) to deploy Copilot securely, establish governance, and encourage organization‑wide adoption.
